```{r}
df_url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/nba2026.csv"
nba2026 =read.csv(df_url)
head(nba2026)
```

```{r}
player_name="Shai Gilgeous-Alexander"

player_series=nba2026 |>
  dplyr::filter(player==player_name)

head(player_series)
```

Time series

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
player_series = player_series |>
  mutate(fantasy_csum=cumsum(fantasy_points),
         game_date=as.Date(game_date))

player_series |>
  ggplot(aes(x=game_date,y=fantasy_csum))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point(shape=2)
```

Change scores

```{r}
player_series |>
  ggplot(aes(game_date,fantasy_points))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()
```

Train/Test Set

```{r}
train=player_series |>
  dplyr::filter(game_date<"2026-02-15")
test=player_series |>
  dplyr::filter(game_date>"2026-02-15")
```

Calculate predictions

Mean/SD of Change Scores

```{r}
cbar=mean(train$fantasy_points)
c_sd=sd(train$fantasy_points)
c(cbar,c_sd)
```

```{r}
intermediate=train$fantasy_csum[49]+cbar*(1:19)
low=intermediate-2*c_sd*sqrt(1:19)
high=intermediate+2*c_sd*sqrt(1:19)
pred_df=data.frame(game=1:19,
          actual=test$fantasy_csum,
          intermediate=intermediate,
          low=low,
          high=high
           )|>
  pivot_longer(actual:high,
             names_to="type",
             values_to="values")

pred_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x=game,y=values,col=type))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()
```
